title: Marketing Manager
description:

 GEM Hospital \& Research Centre, located in Coimbatore, is a leading tertiary care institution specializing in gastroenterology and laparoscopic surgery. Recognized as Asia’s first and most advanced center in its field, it attracts patients from across India and abroad. The hospital offers subspecialties including bariatric, hepatobiliary, colorectal, GI cancer surgery, endogynaecology, and scarless surgery, supported by a 200\-bed, state\-of\-the\-art facility with modern technology and infrastructure. The role also involves organizing promotional activities, maintaining relationships with external partners, agencies, and community organizations, and preparing regular reports and presentations for leadership on marketing outcomes and opportunities.

title: Performance Marketing Executive
description:
This is a hands\-on role for someone who wants to own performance marketing execution for a growing D2C brand — running and optimizing paid campaigns day to day, with direct impact on revenue.
 



 Campaign Execution
 


* Plan, set up, and launch paid campaigns on Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max)
* Manage day\-to\-day budget pacing and bid strategy across campaigns to hit ROAS/CAC targets
* Structure campaigns by product/category and audience segment for clean performance tracking



 Optimization \& Testing
 


* Monitor campaign performance daily — spend, ROAS, CPC, CTR, conversion rate — and optimize creatives, audiences, and placements
* Run structured A/B tests on ad creatives, ad copy, and audience targeting; document what works and what doesn't
* Identify underperforming campaigns early and course\-correct before budget is wasted



 Creative Coordination
 


* Brief the creative/design team on ad formats, hooks, and angles based on performance data
* Maintain a rolling creative testing calendar so new creative is always in the pipeline



 Reporting \& Analysis
 


* Track and report key performance metrics on a regular (weekly/monthly) cadence
* Build simple dashboards in Excel/Google Sheets to track spend, ROAS, CAC, and AOV trends
* Flag budget reallocation opportunities across products/campaigns based on performance



 Requirements:
 


* 1\-2 years of hands\-on experience running Meta and Google Ads campaigns (agency or brand\-side)
* Working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads platform
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets; basic understanding of D2C metrics (ROAS, CAC, AOV, CTR)

title: SEO Analyst
description:
**Role summary** 




 You will take independent, end\-to\-end ownership of an assigned portfolio of Amber Group brand websites, planning and executing their SEO strategies, running technical SEO, driving content and link\-building programs, optimizing for AI answer engines, and reporting results per brand. You will work under the SEO Lead's group strategy, coordinate with developers and designers, and support website migrations. This role owns projects, it does not just support them.
 



**Key responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end monthly SEO for an assigned portfolio of brand websites; develop and execute each site's SEO strategy independently.
* Keyword research, content calendars and content briefs.
* Full on\-page optimization including schema/structured data (Organization, Article, FAQ, Product/Service) validated to zero errors.
* Technical SEO: full site audits (Screaming Frog / Semrush), Search Console error resolution, indexation, redirects, canonical structure and Core Web Vitals monitoring, coordinating fixes with the development team.
* SEO ownership of website migrations and new launches: crawl baselines, redirect mapping, metadata parity and post\-launch monitoring.
* AI\-search optimization (GEO/AEO/AIO): answer\-first content structure, FAQ and schema strategy, AI\-crawler access (robots.txt, llms.txt), and AI\-visibility tracking across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews.
* Off\-page strategy: quality link prospecting, outreach and guest\-post placements.
* Monthly per\-brand reporting: rankings, organic traffic, indexation health, competitor benchmarking and a concrete action plan.



**Required skills \& experience** 



* 1–5 years of hands\-on SEO with demonstrable ranking/traffic results.
* Strong, provable daily use of Google Search Console, GA4 and Semrush; Screaming Frog proficiency.
* Technical SEO depth: redirects, canonicals, indexation control, Core Web Vitals, structured data.
* Experience supporting at least one website migration or major relaunch (preferred).
* Working knowledge of AI\-search optimization: AI crawlers, GEO/AEO concepts, and practical use of AI tools in SEO workflows.
* Proven quality link\-building experience, able to distinguish links that help from links that harm.
* Ability to manage multiple website projects independently and communicate clearly with developers, designers.



**Nice to have** 



* HTML/CSS basics; exposure to modern frameworks (Next.js).
* Local SEO / Google Business Profile experience.



**What you get** 




 Genuine ownership of a multi\-brand portfolio, direct involvement in Next.js migrations and AI\-search programs, and visibility of your results at management level every month.

 Kannan Tools and Dies is an ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 45001 certified manufacturer serving engineering and manufacturing industries since 2000\. Based in Coimbatore, the company is a leading producer and exporter of precision machined components and sub\-assemblies for sectors such as defense, aerospace, space technology, healthcare, heavy engineering, energy, oil and gas, railways, and wind energy. The organization specializes in CNC precision machining and fabrication using a wide range of materials, including titanium alloys, Inconel, nickel alloys, stainless steel, aluminum alloys, duplex and super duplex steels, and other advanced alloys. Kannan Tools and Dies is known for prototype development, reverse engineering, and expertise in machining exotic materials, supported by an R\&D partnership with Kumaraguru College of Technology. title: Junior SEO Analyst
description:
**Role summary** 





 You will execute the monthly SEO activities for assigned Amber Group brand websites under the SEO Lead's direction, creating optimized content, implementing on\-page elements, building quality backlinks, and keeping our SEO documentation accurate. This role is the execution engine of the SEO team and a structured growth path into advanced SEO, AEO and AI\-search (GEO) work.
 




**Key responsibilities** 



* Write and publish SEO\-optimized blog content using AI every month; refresh and improve existing content.
* Implement on\-page SEO elements: meta titles, meta descriptions, heading structure, image alt text, internal links, canonical tags and XML sitemaps (schema markup with guidance).
* Off\-page SEO: quality link building, social bookmarking, directory submissions, business listings, citations and guest\-posting support, with every link tracked and verified.
* Publish content in the CMS with a pre\-publish SEO checklist (metas, links, images, schema).
* Monitor Google Search Console for indexing issues and broken links; escalate technical issues to the SEO Lead.
* Maintain the keyword, content and backlink trackers accurately and daily.
* Provide weekly reporting inputs from Search Console and GA4\.
* Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude etc.) responsibly for research and drafts, always fact\-checked and human\-edited before publishing.



**Required skills \& experience** 



* 1–2 years of hands\-on SEO experience (agency or in\-house).
* Working knowledge of Google Search Console and GA4; exposure to Semrush, Screaming Frog.
* Solid grasp of on\-page and off\-page fundamentals; basic HTML familiarity.
* Hands\-on familiarity with AI tools for content and research workflows.
* A self\-driven learner: this role comes with a structured 13\-week learning plan across SEO, AEO, GEO, AIO and AXO, and we expect genuine ownership of it.



  





**Nice to have** 



* CMS experience.
* Basic schema/structured\-data knowledge (FAQ, Article).
* Awareness of AEO/GEO, how content gets cited by AI engines.



**What you get** 





 Exposure to 15\+ live websites across industries, a defined learning path with weekly mentoring from the SEO Lead, and hands\-on work in AI\-search optimization, the fastest\-growing area of the field.
